skipped.reason: Terms & Conditions (Jan 2025) explicitly prohibit automated extraction/scraping of data and copying/downloading website material without written consent (quote in sources.kronospan-terms). Catalog data NOT collected. Note: the data exists in a structured form — decor list via POST /<locale>/ajax/decors/init_decores and per-decor pages /<locale>/decors/view/kronodesign/<collection>/<code> which publish, per product (ЛДСП, ЛМДФ), a thickness x format availability matrix (e.g. K001 PW ЛДСП: 8,10,12,16,18,19,22,25,28,38 mm, format 2800x2070, 18 mm in stock, others on request) and 'Тип декора' (e.g. Дуб/Камень/Цвет). Kazakhstan locale is ru_KZ (mirrors RU). Usable only with Kronospan's written permission (info@kronospan.com).
Same terms cover PDFs in Digital Library (downloading/storing material without consent prohibited).
Domains do not resolve (2026-09-25); kronospan-express.com redirects to kronospan.com (404 page). No separate CIS catalog site exists.

Terms of Use explicitly forbid copying/reproducing/republishing any website materials (incl. text and documents) without written permission of KEAS (quote in sources.kastamonu-terms). kastamonu.ru redirects to kastamonuentegre.com/ru_ru, same terms. Decor catalog, Evogloss, catalogues PDFs (/ru_ru/katalogi) not collected. Permission contact: via /ru_ru/svyazatsya-s-nami.

Russian resellers that self-describe as 'официальный дилер завода Кроношпан' (plit-centr lists e.g. 'ЛДСП K001 PW Дуб Крафт Белый', 2800х2070 мм). Not collected: dealer status not verified against a manufacturer dealer list, they are price/stock shops rather than manufacturer catalogs, and harvesting them would effectively bypass Kronospan's own anti-scraping terms. Left as a decision for the coordinator.
Found in search; laminate.kz is a flooring (laminate) distributor, 12.kz a retailer — not chipboard decor catalogs. Not collected.

notes: Both manufacturers in scope have terms that explicitly forbid copying/extracting site content without written permission, so per the brief no decor data was recorded. Kronospan: ru_KZ/ru_RU decor range ~236 Kronodesign decors across 26 collections (from a discovery request made before the terms were read; the response was deleted, nothing kept). Per-decor pages publish thickness/format matrices per product (ЛДСП format 2800x2070 seen for K001) and a 'Тип декора' classification usable for grain — worth requesting permission from info@kronospan.com. Kastamonu: decor/Evogloss data under /ru_ru/tovary/mdf-dsp and /ru_ru/tovary/evogloss plus PDF catalogues at /ru_ru/katalogi; not examined beyond the terms. Raw downloads of catalog data were deleted; only terms/home pages kept under research/raw/kronospan-kastamonu/.
